categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Kaier New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: interior enamel decorative materials used in subway, tunnel, and public facility interiors; industrial protective enamel materials for coal-fired power plants, boilers, and steel mills focusing on energy-saving and environmental protection; and enamel green building curtain wall materials for high-end properties and public facility exteriors. The company also engages in curtain wall decoration engineering services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced enamel technology by fusing inorganic non-metallic enamel glaze with steel substrates at temperatures above 800°C to create durable, corrosion-resistant, and aesthetically versatile functional enamel materials. It employs a combination of in-house production for core components and outsourced processing for labor-intensive, low-value-added steps. The company emphasizes digital and intelligent manufacturing, integrating automation, lean management, and digital systems to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include owners or general contractors of large public infrastructure projects such as subways and tunnels, coal-fired power plants and other energy sectors requiring environmental protection equipment, and owners or contractors of high-end commercial and public buildings. The company’s products serve markets in urban infrastructure, energy-saving and environmental protection industries, and green building decoration sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are predominantly domestic within China, with over 99% of revenue generated from the domestic market. Overseas sales are minimal, accounting for less than 1% of total revenue. The company’s headquarters and main production facilities are located in Jinhua, Zhejiang Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Kaier New Materials operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and direct sales of functional enamel materials and related products. It serves downstream customers in construction, energy, and industrial sectors, providing specialized materials and engineering services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in enamel technology, focusing on developing high-performance, multi-functional enamel products with enhanced durability, aesthetics, and environmental benefits. R&D efforts include microcrystalline composite toughened enamel boards, lightweight ultra-matte enamel panels, and acid-resistant electrostatic powders for heat exchange elements. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to strengthen its technology pipeline and aims to accelerate new product commercialization and digital transformation in manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of enamel materials and related products to industrial and construction clients, mainly via bidding and contract agreements. The company also earns income from engineering services related to curtain wall decoration and receives government subsidies and investment income from financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhejiang Kaier New Materials is a leading domestic player and recognized industry pioneer in the new functional enamel materials sector in China. It holds a dominant market position in specialized enamel products for infrastructure and green building applications, supported by strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio. The company faces intensified competition due to market demand fluctuations and pricing pressures but maintains competitive advantages through technology and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 448.6 million, a 27% decline from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 23.7 million, down 68%. Despite revenue contraction due to slow downstream demand and market competition, operating cash flow improved by 49%. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.35 billion and equity of RMB 1.14 billion, reflecting a stable but challenged financial scale with ongoing efforts to optimize operations and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its enamel materials’ superior durability, corrosion resistance, environmental friendliness, and aesthetic versatility, tailored for demanding applications in urban infrastructure, energy-saving equipment, and high-end green buildings. Its products offer long service life, easy maintenance, and customizable designs, supported by proprietary technologies and patents. The company’s integrated service model, combining product innovation with project support and digital manufacturing, differentiates it in the market.
